reason: Native round-wide defense strategy, the server morale override and idle CT defense trials change the order of the shared engine random stream. Pin the consequences using the pre-feature parent as the independent control.
control: Export the base commit. Add only lookup/registration of bot_excellent_morale (0, flags 0) and its fake-engine registry entry. At each new round decision, consume the engine random float [0,100] immediately after the planting delay and store whether the result is <=33.3. In the baseline CT idle bomb-map path before the normal state update, consume one engine random float [0,100] when the bot has valid NAV, is cooperative, the team is holding, no planted or known loose bomb or task takes priority, and the bot is safe or has not seen an enemy for >30 seconds. All eligible actors in this replay have nonnegative morale and no sniper rifle. No state transition or candidate code is part of the control. On both platforms the single eligible CT trial is slot 1, round 25, frame 1593, roll 87.366. The unmodified parent must first match the preceding five reviewed corrections byte for byte.
